(() => { const json = document.getElementById('json-output'); if (!json) throw new Error('missing json'); if (json.textContent.includes('aspect_ratio')) throw new Error('aspect leaked'); [...document.querySelectorAll('nav[aria-label="Clusters"] button')].find((b) => b.textContent.includes('Framing')).click(); return 'opened-framing'; })()

(() => { const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].map((n) => n.textContent.trim()); if (labels.includes('Aspect ratio')) throw new Error(labels.join('|')); if (!labels.includes('Named principle') || !labels.includes('Elevation & axis')) throw new Error(labels.join('|')); return 'framing-ok'; })()
(() => { if (document.getElementById('json-output')) throw new Error('still open'); return 'hidden-ok'; })()

(() => { const pre = document.getElementById('json-output'); if (!pre) throw new Error('no json'); if (document.querySelector('label')) throw new Error('fields still up'); const h = Math.round(pre.getBoundingClientRect().height); if (h < 300) throw new Error('short ' + h); return 'full-ok ' + h; })()
(() => { document.querySelector('[aria-label="Show a fraction of the JSON"]').click(); return 'peek'; })()
(() => { const h = Math.round(document.getElementById('json-output').getBoundingClientRect().height); if (h > 220) throw new Error('peek tall ' + h); return 'peek-ok ' + h; })()

(() => { const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.includes('Character') && b.textContent.includes('a young elven ranger')); if (!card) throw new Error('no card'); const id = document.getElementById('subjects.0.subject_id'); const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(id, ''); id.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'cleared'; })()

(() => { const id = document.getElementById('subjects.0.subject_id'); if (id.value !== '') throw new Error('not cleared ' + id.value); [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.includes('Character') && b.textContent.includes('a young elven ranger')).click(); return 'use'; })()

(() => { const id = document.getElementById('subjects.0.subject_id'); if (id.value !== 'a young elven ranger') throw new Error(id.value); [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Add as subject').click(); return 'add'; })()
(() => { const n = (document.getElementById('json-output').textContent.match(/"subject_id"/g) || []).length; if (n !== 2) throw new Error('subjects ' + n); return 'characters-ok'; })()
